
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/fnlingnzb-learner/p/19073518" title="发布于 2025-09-04 14:27">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">spark streaming消费rocketmq的几种方式</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-start="13" data-end="49">在 Spark 里接入 <strong data-start="25" data-end="37">RocketMQ</strong>，主要有两大类方式：</p>
<hr data-start="51" data-end="54">
<h2 data-start="56" data-end="106">🔹 1. 基于 <strong data-start="68" data-end="104">老的 Spark Streaming (DStream API)</strong></h2>
<p data-start="108" data-end="210">RocketMQ 社区提供过 <strong data-start="123" data-end="141">rocketmq-spark</strong> connector（在 <code data-start="154" data-end="181">apache/rocketmq-externals</code> 里），可以像 Kafka 一样创建 DStream：</p>
<h3 data-start="212" data-end="234">方式 A：Receiver 模式</h3>
<ul data-start="235" data-end="418">
<li data-start="235" data-end="273">
<p data-start="237" data-end="273">使用自定义的 <code data-start="244" data-end="254">Receiver</code> 从 RocketMQ 拉取消息。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="274" data-end="326">
<p data-start="276" data-end="326">每条消息进入 Spark Streaming 的 <code data-start="301" data-end="323">ReceiverInputDStream</code>。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="327" data-end="339">
<p data-start="329" data-end="339">优点：实现简单。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="340" data-end="418">
<p data-start="342" data-end="418">缺点：消息会先缓存在 Spark executor 的内存里，容错依赖 Spark 的 WAL（Write Ahead Log），性能和可靠性一般。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4>a. 不使用WAL（Write Ahead Log）</h4>
<p data-start="73" data-end="86"><strong>核心思路是：</strong></p>
<ul data-start="87" data-end="260">
<li data-start="87" data-end="153">
<p data-start="89" data-end="153">在 Spark 里实现一个自定义 <code data-start="106" data-end="119">Receiver&lt;T&gt;</code>，内部运行 <strong data-start="125" data-end="150">RocketMQ PushConsumer</strong>。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="154" data-end="221">
<p data-start="156" data-end="221">PushConsumer 收到消息后，调用 <code data-start="178" data-end="190">store(msg)</code> 把数据写入 Spark Streaming 的内存队列。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="222" data-end="260">
<p data-start="224" data-end="260">Spark Streaming 后续把这些数据打包成 RDD 处理。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="267" data-end="279"><strong>核心流程：</strong></p>
<ol data-start="281" data-end="479">
<li data-start="281" data-end="336">
<p data-start="284" data-end="313"><strong data-start="284" data-end="311">RocketMQ → PushConsumer</strong></p>
<ul data-start="317" data-end="336">
<li data-start="317" data-end="336">
<p data-start="319" data-end="336">消息推送到 Spark 进程。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="337" data-end="425">
<p data-start="340" data-end="370"><strong data-start="340" data-end="368">Spark Receiver → store()</strong></p>
<ul data-start="374" data-end="425">
<li data-start="374" data-end="425">
<p data-start="376" data-end="425">Receiver 缓存消息，存到 Spark executor 的 BlockManager。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="426" data-end="479">
<p data-start="429" data-end="454"><strong data-start="429" data-end="452">Spark Streaming Job</strong></p>
<ul data-start="458" data-end="479">
<li data-start="458" data-end="479">
<p data-start="460" data-end="479">定时将数据生成 RDD 进行处理。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="486" data-end="498"><strong>示例代码</strong></p>
<h3 data-start="500" data-end="515">1️⃣ Order 类</h3>

<p>3️⃣ Spark Streaming 主程序</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> org.apache.spark.SparkConf;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> org.apache.spark.streaming.Durations;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> org.apache.spark.streaming.api.java.JavaReceiverInputDStream;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception {

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         stream.foreachRDD(rdd -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>             rdd.foreach(order -&gt; System.out.println("Got order: " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> order));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ssc.start();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ssc.awaitTermination();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h4 data-start="4328" data-end="4349"><strong>b.&nbsp;</strong>使用WAL（Write Ahead Log）</h4>
<p data-start="81" data-end="114">在 Spark Streaming 里，开启 WAL 很简单：</p>
<ol data-start="115" data-end="274">
<li data-start="115" data-end="157">
<p data-start="118" data-end="157"><strong data-start="118" data-end="138">设置 checkpoint 目录</strong>（必须是 HDFS 或可靠存储）；</p>
</li>
<li data-start="158" data-end="226">
<p data-start="161" data-end="226">Receiver 要用 <code data-start="173" data-end="211">StorageLevel.MEMORY_AND_DISK_SER_2()</code>（支持 WAL 持久化）；</p>
</li>
<li data-start="227" data-end="274">
<p data-start="230" data-end="274">Spark 自动把每条接收到的数据先写到 WAL，再交给 BlockManager。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="281" data-end="300"><strong>🚀 完整示例代码（带 WAL）</strong></p>
<p data-start="302" data-end="324">1️⃣ Order 类（和之前相同）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.io.Serializable;

<p>3️⃣ 主程序（开启 WAL 需要 checkpoint）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> org.apache.spark.SparkConf;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-start="4422" data-end="4432"><strong>注意事项</strong></p>
<ol data-start="4433" data-end="4680">
<li data-start="4433" data-end="4486">
<p data-start="4436" data-end="4486"><strong data-start="4436" data-end="4466">checkpoint 必须是 HDFS/S3/OSS</strong> 等分布式存储，本地路径只适合测试。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4487" data-end="4551">
<p data-start="4490" data-end="4551">WAL 会写日志文件，保证 <strong data-start="4504" data-end="4527">至少一次（at-least-once）</strong> 语义，但仍可能有重复消息，需要业务端去重。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4552" data-end="4600">
<p data-start="4555" data-end="4600">Receiver 模式 + WAL 性能比 Direct 模式差（多一次磁盘 IO）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4601" data-end="4680">
<p data-start="4604" data-end="4680">若想要 <strong data-start="4608" data-end="4624">exactly-once</strong>，通常推荐 Structured Streaming（自动 checkpoint + sink 支持事务）。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 data-start="4328" data-end="4349">⚠️ Receiver 模式特点</h4>
<p data-start="4351" data-end="4361">✅ <strong data-start="4353" data-end="4359">优点</strong></p>
<ul data-start="4362" data-end="4428">
<li data-start="4362" data-end="4408">
<p data-start="4364" data-end="4408">实现简单：直接用 RocketMQ PushConsumer 推消息到 Spark。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4409" data-end="4428">
<p data-start="4411" data-end="4428">不需要手动管理 offset。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="4430" data-end="4440">❌ <strong data-start="4432" data-end="4438">缺点</strong></p>
<ul data-start="4441" data-end="4596">
<li data-start="4441" data-end="4502">
<p data-start="4443" data-end="4502">Spark Receiver 先把数据存到内存（BlockManager），如果 Spark 崩溃，数据可能丢失。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4503" data-end="4567">
<p data-start="4505" data-end="4567">容错要依赖 <strong data-start="4511" data-end="4535">WAL（Write Ahead Log）</strong>，但 WAL 会写 HDFS，性能比 Direct 模式差。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4568" data-end="4596">
<p data-start="4570" data-end="4596">难以保证严格 <strong data-start="4577" data-end="4593">exactly-once</strong>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 data-start="420" data-end="440">方式 B：Direct 模式</h3>
<ul data-start="441" data-end="627">
<li data-start="441" data-end="521">
<p data-start="443" data-end="521">类似 Kafka Direct Stream，Spark Streaming 直接从 RocketMQ 拉取数据，不依赖 Spark Receiver。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="522" data-end="571">
<p data-start="524" data-end="571">消息 offset 由用户管理，可以手动提交（通常写到 Zookeeper 或外部存储）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="572" data-end="595">
<p data-start="574" data-end="595">优点：性能更好，保证数据至少一次处理。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="596" data-end="627">
<p data-start="598" data-end="627">缺点：需要自己管理 offset 提交，开发复杂一些。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="0" data-end="89">而Direct 模式的特点是：</p>
<ul data-start="90" data-end="238">
<li data-start="90" data-end="124">
<p data-start="92" data-end="124">不依赖 Spark Receiver（没有 WAL 开销）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="125" data-end="160">
<p data-start="127" data-end="160">Spark Driver 直接从 RocketMQ 拉取消息。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="161" data-end="238">
<p data-start="163" data-end="238">消费的 offset 由 <strong data-start="176" data-end="195">Spark Driver 维护</strong>，通常要手动存储到外部（比如 HDFS、MySQL、Zookeeper）以便恢复。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-start="245" data-end="257">实现思路</h4>
<ol data-start="259" data-end="731">
<li data-start="259" data-end="527">
<p data-start="262" data-end="292"><strong data-start="262" data-end="290">准备 RocketMQ Consumer API</strong></p>
<ul data-start="296" data-end="527">
<li data-start="296" data-end="392">
<p data-start="298" data-end="392">Spark 没有内置 RocketMQ Direct API（像 Kafka 那样），需要借助 <strong data-start="346" data-end="374">rocketmq-spark connector</strong> 或者自定义 Consumer。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="396" data-end="527">
<p data-start="398" data-end="426">原理和 Kafka DirectStream 一样：</p>
<ul data-start="432" data-end="527">
<li data-start="432" data-end="497">
<p data-start="434" data-end="497">在每个 micro-batch 触发时，去 RocketMQ 拉取一段消息（指定起始 offset、结束 offset）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="503" data-end="527">
<p data-start="505" data-end="527">转换成 RDD，交给 Spark 执行。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="529" data-end="731">
<p data-start="532" data-end="541"><strong data-start="532" data-end="539">关键点</strong></p>
<ul data-start="545" data-end="731">
<li data-start="545" data-end="626">
<p data-start="547" data-end="626"><strong data-start="547" data-end="562">手动管理 offset</strong>：RocketMQ 不会自动帮 Spark 提交，需要你把 offset 存到外部存储（比如 HDFS/ZK/MySQL）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="630" data-end="691">
<p data-start="632" data-end="691"><strong data-start="632" data-end="639">并行度</strong>：可以按 Topic 的 Queue（partition 类似）拆分 RDD，分发到不同 task。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="695" data-end="731">
<p data-start="697" data-end="731"><strong data-start="697" data-end="703">容错</strong>：作业失败后，重新从存储的 offset 位置恢复。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 data-start="738" data-end="762">🚀 代码示例（Direct 模式伪实现）</h4>
<p data-start="764" data-end="799">假设有 <code data-start="768" data-end="780">OrderTopic</code>，包含多个 MessageQueue：</p>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">80</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">81</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">82</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h4 data-start="3785" data-end="3797">关键点说明</h4>
<ol data-start="3799" data-end="4150">
<li data-start="3799" data-end="3936">
<p data-start="3802" data-end="3817"><strong data-start="3802" data-end="3815">offset 管理</strong></p>
<ul data-start="3821" data-end="3936">
<li data-start="3821" data-end="3863">
<p data-start="3823" data-end="3863"><code data-start="3823" data-end="3836">offsetTable</code> 记录每个 MessageQueue 的消费位置。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3867" data-end="3909">
<p data-start="3869" data-end="3909">每个 batch 消费后更新，并写入外部存储（比如 MySQL/HDFS）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3913" data-end="3936">
<p data-start="3915" data-end="3936">程序重启时先从外部恢复 offset。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="3938" data-end="4042">
<p data-start="3941" data-end="3950"><strong data-start="3941" data-end="3948">并行度</strong></p>
<ul data-start="3954" data-end="4042">
<li data-start="3954" data-end="4042">
<p data-start="3956" data-end="4042">可以用 <code data-start="3960" data-end="3984">sc.parallelize(orders)</code>，但更高效的是：每个 <code data-start="3995" data-end="4009">MessageQueue</code> 映射成一个 RDD 分片，利用 Spark 分布式并行消费。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="4044" data-end="4150">
<p data-start="4047" data-end="4057"><strong data-start="4047" data-end="4055">语义保证</strong></p>
<ul data-start="4061" data-end="4150">
<li data-start="4061" data-end="4100">
<p data-start="4063" data-end="4100">默认 at-least-once，可能会有重复消费，需要结合业务去重。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4104" data-end="4150">
<p data-start="4106" data-end="4150">如果 offset 和结果同时事务写入，可以做到 effectively-once。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="4157" data-end="4165">📌 总结：</p>
<ul data-start="4166" data-end="4327">
<li data-start="4166" data-end="4195">
<p data-start="4168" data-end="4195"><strong data-start="4168" data-end="4183">Receiver 模式</strong> → 简单但性能差。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4196" data-end="4247">
<p data-start="4198" data-end="4247"><strong data-start="4198" data-end="4211">Direct 模式</strong> → 手动拉取 offset，性能高，但需要自己管理 offset。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4248" data-end="4327">
<p data-start="4250" data-end="4327"><strong data-start="4250" data-end="4274">Structured Streaming</strong> → 推荐的现代方案，自动 offset 管理，SQL API，更容易保证 exactly-once。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="629" data-end="632">
<h2 data-start="634" data-end="696">🔹 2. 基于 <strong data-start="646" data-end="694">Structured Streaming (DataFrame/Dataset API)</strong></h2>
<p data-start="698" data-end="790">Structured Streaming 是 Spark 2.x 之后推荐的流处理 API。RocketMQ Connector 也支持 Structured Streaming：</p>
<h3 data-start="792" data-end="812">方式 A：作为 Source</h3>
<p data-start="813" data-end="820">直接通过：</p>
<div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary">
<div class="sticky top-9">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> spark.readStream() .format("org.apache.rocketmq.spark") .option("namesrvAddr", "localhost:9876") .option("consumerGroup", "test_group") .option("topics", "OrderTopic") .load();</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1030" data-end="1050">得到一个 DataFrame，包含：</p>
<ul data-start="1051" data-end="1128">
<li data-start="1051" data-end="1060">
<p data-start="1053" data-end="1060"><code data-start="1053" data-end="1058">key</code></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1061" data-end="1071">
<p data-start="1063" data-end="1071"><code data-start="1063" data-end="1069">body</code></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1072" data-end="1083">
<p data-start="1074" data-end="1083"><code data-start="1074" data-end="1081">topic</code></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1084" data-end="1094">
<p data-start="1086" data-end="1094"><code data-start="1086" data-end="1092">tags</code></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1095" data-end="1107">
<p data-start="1097" data-end="1107"><code data-start="1097" data-end="1105">offset</code></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1108" data-end="1128">
<p data-start="1110" data-end="1128"><code data-start="1110" data-end="1121">timestamp</code> 等字段。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1130" data-end="1165"><strong data-start="1130" data-end="1154">offset 自动 checkpoint</strong>，不需要手动提交。</p>
<hr data-start="1167" data-end="1170">
<h3 data-start="1172" data-end="1190">方式 B：作为 Sink</h3>
<p data-start="1191" data-end="1231">Structured Streaming 也能把结果写回 RocketMQ：</p>
<div class="contain-inline-size rounded-2xl relative bg-token-sidebar-surface-primary">
<div class="sticky top-9">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> df.writeStream() .format("org.apache.rocketmq.spark") .option("namesrvAddr", "localhost:9876") .option("producerGroup", "result_group") .option("topic", "ResultTopic") .start();</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1442" data-end="1481">这样 Spark 的计算结果会被写到另一个 RocketMQ topic。</p>
<hr data-start="1483" data-end="1486">
<h2 data-start="1488" data-end="1520">🔹 3. 自己实现 Consumer → Spark</h2>
<p data-start="1522" data-end="1549">如果不想用官方 connector，也可以自己写：</p>
<ol data-start="1550" data-end="1696">
<li data-start="1550" data-end="1596">
<p data-start="1553" data-end="1596">在 Spark 里启动一个 <strong data-start="1567" data-end="1593">RocketMQ Java Consumer</strong>。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1597" data-end="1652">
<p data-start="1600" data-end="1652">消费消息后，把数据写到 Spark Streaming 的队列（例如 <code data-start="1635" data-end="1648">queueStream</code>）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1653" data-end="1696">
<p data-start="1656" data-end="1696">Spark Streaming 从这个队列里生成 DStream 进行计算。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="1698" data-end="1773">👉 这种方式灵活，但 offset 管理和 exactly-once 语义都要自己处理，一般不推荐，除非你有特殊需求（比如自定义序列化/解码）。</p>
<hr data-start="1775" data-end="1778">
<h2 data-start="1780" data-end="1788">🔎 总结</h2>
<ul data-start="1789" data-end="2056">
<li data-start="1789" data-end="1889">
<p data-start="1791" data-end="1826"><strong data-start="1791" data-end="1823">老的 Spark Streaming (DStream)</strong>：</p>
<ul data-start="1829" data-end="1889">
<li data-start="1829" data-end="1854">
<p data-start="1831" data-end="1854">Receiver 模式（简单，但容错差）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1857" data-end="1889">
<p data-start="1859" data-end="1889">Direct 模式（性能好，可手动提交 offset）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="1890" data-end="1995">
<p data-start="1892" data-end="1919"><strong data-start="1892" data-end="1916">Structured Streaming</strong>：</p>
<ul data-start="1922" data-end="1995">
<li data-start="1922" data-end="1974">
<p data-start="1924" data-end="1974">推荐方式，作为 RocketMQ Source（offset 自动管理，SQL API 简洁）。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1977" data-end="1995">
<p data-start="1979" data-end="1995">可以写回 RocketMQ。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="1996" data-end="2056">
<p data-start="1998" data-end="2030"><strong data-start="1998" data-end="2027">自研 Consumer + queueStream</strong>：</p>
<ul data-start="2033" data-end="2056">
<li data-start="2033" data-end="2056">
<p data-start="2035" data-end="2056">灵活，但 offset、容错全靠自己。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2063" data-end="2136" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">&nbsp;</p>

</div>
